descriptionText: Enhance your Pokémon TCG collection with this ultra-rare Hisuian Arcanine V card from the Sword & Shield - Silver Tempest set. This holo card boasts 230 HP and belongs to the Fighting attribute. It is perfect for gamers and collectors alike, with its rarity and striking finish. The card number is 090/195, and it is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG player. Add this card to your deck and watch it become the centerpiece of your strategy.
